provider.description: Writes instances to GeoParquet files, one file per type. The default geometry of a type is written to the primary geometry column, other top-level geometry properties to additional geometry columns. GML geometry properties (e.g. of type gml:GeometryPropertyType) are written as geometries, gml:boundedBy is not written (the bbox column and the geo metadata provide the extent). Geometries in nested properties and in JSON columns are written as WKT in their source CRS (no CRS conversion). Measure (M) values of geometries are not written (a warning is reported). For geometry columns with Z values the column bbox in the geo metadata has 6 values as required by the GeoParquet specification, which Portolan 0.8.0 does not read correctly (see the parameter bbox2d).
provider.name: GeoParquet file

providerParameter.description: Coordinate reference system the geometries of all geometry columns are transformed to and written in. Takes precedence over the CRS defined in the schema or by the geometries. If it has no EPSG code (e.g. defined only as WKT), the geometries are still transformed to it, but the CRS is written as unknown (crs: null) and a warning is reported; Portolan does not accept such files if the coordinates are outside the lon/lat range. If no target CRS is set, the CRS of each geometry column is determined from the schema or the first geometry with a CRS; in streaming mode (sort disabled), an additional geometry column whose first value only appears after the file of the type was opened (once the CRS of the primary geometry is known) gets an unknown CRS.
providerParameter.label: Target CRS
providerParameter.name: crs

valueDescriptor.defaultDescription: By default the CRS defined in the schema is used, otherwise the CRS of the first geometry with a CRS of each type. Geometries are transformed to that CRS.
valueDescriptor.sampleDescription: Reference systems can be defined either as code or WKT (preceded with code: or wkt: respectively)

providerParameter.description: The version of the GeoParquet specification to write. Version 2.0.0 uses the native Parquet GEOMETRY type, versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 write plain binary columns with the geo metadata. Note that Portolan does not accept version 1.0.0.
providerParameter.label: GeoParquet version
providerParameter.name: geoparquet.version

providerParameter.description: The compression codec for the Parquet files (zstd, snappy, gzip or none)
providerParameter.label: Compression
providerParameter.name: compression

valueDescriptor.defaultDescription: By default ZSTD compression is used

providerParameter.description: Sort the instances spatially (Hilbert curve) to improve the performance of spatial queries on the file. Sorting resolves instances by reference and can be slow for sources where that is expensive (e.g. GML read directly), use an instance store or disable sorting in that case. When sorting, a type that has a geometry property but no instance with geometry is written as plain Parquet file (without GeoParquet metadata), as a GeoParquet file without geometries is not accepted by Portolan; without sorting the instances of a type are buffered until the CRS is known (at most 1000 instances), only if the input ends before that it is known that there is no geometry and the type is written as plain Parquet file, otherwise it is written as GeoParquet file without extent.
providerParameter.label: Sort spatially
providerParameter.name: sort

valueDescriptor.defaultDescription: By default this option is enabled

providerParameter.description: The maximum number of rows per row group. Note that values above 150000 violate the requirements of Portolan.
providerParameter.label: Row group size
providerParameter.name: rowGroupRowLimit

valueDescriptor.defaultDescription: By default row groups contain at most 150000 rows

providerParameter.description: The maximum nesting depth of properties that are written as Parquet structs, properties nested deeper are written as JSON text
providerParameter.label: Maximum nesting depth
providerParameter.name: nestingDepth

valueDescriptor.defaultDescription: By default a nesting depth of 5 is used

providerParameter.description: How BigInteger and BigDecimal values are written: as string (lossless), as double (lossy) or as decimal (precision 38)
providerParameter.label: Big number encoding
providerParameter.name: bigNumberEncoding

valueDescriptor.defaultDescription: By default big numbers are written as string

providerParameter.description: The scale used for BigDecimal values when the big number encoding is decimal (the precision is always 38)
providerParameter.label: Decimal scale
providerParameter.name: decimalScale

valueDescriptor.defaultDescription: By default a scale of 9 is used

providerParameter.description: Write the column bbox in the geo metadata as 2D bbox [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] also for geometry columns with Z values. For such columns the GeoParquet specification requires a bbox with 6 values [xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax], but Portolan 0.8.0 only reads the first four values: it reports a mismatch between the data and the bbox (PTL-DAT-005) and writes a wrong bbox to the catalog. Enabling this option writes a 2D bbox that Portolan reads correctly, at the cost of not following the GeoParquet specification for 3D data (a warning is reported for each affected column). The Z values of the geometries are written in any case.
providerParameter.label: 2D bbox for 3D data (Portolan)
providerParameter.name: bbox2d

valueDescriptor.defaultDescription: By default this option is disabled, the bbox of a column with Z values has 6 values as required by the GeoParquet specification

providerParameter.description: Overwrite the target file if it exists
providerParameter.label: Overwrite target file
providerParameter.name: overwriteTargetFile

valueDescriptor.defaultDescription: By default this option is disabled
